CHOSEN DIRECTION — Beta 1 interface.

B · Mixer rack, with the owner's adjustments applied 2026-08-23:

1. Real keyboard geometry — white keys tiled, half-height black keys straddling the seam, octave labels C-2 to C7, JUCE's translucent yellow key-down overlay. The first pass drew flat stripes.
2. Row spacing fixed — 12px between every group, so Solo no longer collides with the instrument name.
3. Accent moved off the canvas chrome into a settings popover in the plugin itself.

Not implemented. This artboard is the spec.

The gear opens this. It holds what has nowhere else to live: accent choice, engine facts worth quoting in a bug report, version, and the two links the tester guide already asks people to use.

It is also where later settings land, so they don't get bolted onto the header one at a time.

Not chosen — kept for reference.

A was the least-change option, C moved the rack into a list-plus-detail split, D collapsed everything into a header with per-row activity meters. Ideas worth stealing later: C's read-only reverb send per channel, D's activity meter.
